en: The postcard features an old photograph showing a lively public square with well-dressed people in late 19th or early 20th-century attire. Behind them are elegant buildings with classical architectural features and ornate balconies. The printed text on the image side reads 'Bad Pyrmont Brunnenplatz', indicating a notable square in the German spa town of Bad Pyrmont. The reverse side has pre-printed sections for a message and address, and a museum stamp indicating 'Museum im Schloss Bad Pyrmont'. The overall design and typeface suggest an early 20th-century origin.
